title: Reminder timing rows are in days with a protected due-date row
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A schedule open in the editor with a service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open a schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the service form.
  5. Reach the reminder-timing step of a new routine service form.
custom_steps:
1. Read the default reminder rows on a new service.
  2. Read a row's controls ([before|after] [n] [days]).
  3. Try to delete the due-date row; keep adding rows past five.
  4. Add two identical rows, and a "before" row longer than the service's calendar interval.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Reminder timing is one list of rows, each reading [ before | after ] [ n ] [ days ] - in days and nothing else; timing is per service.
  • Every new service starts with three default rows: 14 days before, on the due date, and 7 days after.
  • The due-date row cannot be deleted (its delete control is disabled, not hidden); the ceiling is five rows, after which Add reminder disables.
  • Days run 1 to 365; two identical rows cannot both be saved; a "before" row longer than the calendar interval is refused inline.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10562 (S5, Reminder timing); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S5; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R1: “Reminder timing is set on each service, as one list of rows, each reading [ before | after ] [ n ] [ days ]. Rows are in days and nothing else”
  • S5-R2: “Every new service starts with three default rows: 14 days before, on the due date, and 7 days after”
  • S5-R3: “The due date row cannot be deleted. Its delete control is disabled, not hidden”
  • S5-R4: “The ceiling is five rows, after which Add reminder disables”
  • S5-R12: “A reminder row's days run 1 to 365. Two identical rows cannot both be saved, and a before row longer than the service's calendar interval is refused inline”
